Key Features to Look For

- Low waiting period for pre-existing diseases (1-2 years)

- No co-payment or low co-payment

- No room rent limit

- Restoration benefit

- Annual health checkup

Tax Benefits (Section 80D)

- Self (below 60) + parents (60+): Up to Rs. 75,000

- Self (60+) + parents (60+): Up to Rs. 1,00,000

- Parents 80+ without insurance: Up to Rs. 50,000 for medical expenses
